annotations.title: Your own OAuth apps for connecting accounts

description: WHITE LABEL: connect your customers' accounts through YOUR OWN app on a platform (Facebook, Instagram, Google, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest and more), so the platform's consent screen shows your app's name instead of Hermoso's. action platforms: which platforms take one, and the redirect address to allow in your app's console. list / get: your apps (client id, status ok / unchecked / invalid, how many connections run on each; the secret is never shown). add: platform, label, clientId, clientSecret (and configId for a Facebook app that should also do WhatsApp signup); the keys are checked with the platform first and refused if it rejects them. One app per platform, for the whole account: every connect and token refresh for that platform then runs on it, so existing connections made with Hermoso's app must be reconnected, which is why add asks for confirm:true when there are some. update: label, a new clientSecret (checked first), configId. check: re-check the keys. remove: confirm:true. Account owner or admin only. Free.

appId.description: get / update / check / remove: from list

clientId.description: add: the app id / client id from the platform console

clientSecret.description: add / update: the app secret; stored encrypted, never shown again

configId.description: Facebook app only: its WhatsApp Embedded Signup configuration id

confirm.description: true after the user agreed (add over existing connections, remove)

label.description: a name you will recognise the app by

platform.description: add: e.g. facebook, google, microsoft, linkedin, tiktok, x, pinterest (action platforms lists them)
